_note: Audit F7 — the single canonical pipeline DAG. This is the ONE source of truth for phase order and dependencies. orchestrator.md's stage table and pipeline_state.json.stages_completed MUST be generated from / reconciled against this file. Key invariant: `design` precedes `qa_generate` because qa_generate declares spec/design.md as a required input.

qa_generate._dependency_note: MUST run after design — declares spec/design.md as a required input (fixes F7).

review.model: claude-sonnet-4-6 (escalates to claude-opus-4-8 on hotspot/security diffs)

diff_agent._note: Not a linear stage. Invoked by the orchestrator only on a requirements delta; emits spec/rerun_plan.json that prunes the order above to the affected stages.

discovery._note: Depth-4 / R5. Optional Phase-0 node, NOT in canonical_order (like operate/diff_agent). Invoked by the orchestrator only for greenfield/epic scope (sdlc-config.json#discovery); ordinary tasks skip straight to requirements. Frames the problem BEFORE requirements; does NOT freeze them (unfrozen-requirement research stays a spike outside the pipeline — docs/SDLC-SPEC.md §1.6). Adds NO new mandatory gate — brief sign-off folds into cp_01/G1 (engine cp_01–cp_08 untouched).

operate._note: Not a linear stage (Depth-2 Block 3). Invoked by the orchestrator on a production-incident trigger, NOT part of canonical_order. Mitigates rollback-first via devops_agent, then routes the permanent fix back through the normal stages as a linked Bug (the same gates apply; cp_08 stays mandatory). Emits incidents/<INC-id>.json. Closes the SDLC loop. See docs/INCIDENT.md.
operate.principle: rollback-first; fix flows through the normal pipeline; blameless post-incident asks which gate should have caught it
